data.summary: E096 experiment demonstrated that the view-count principle generalizes to aviation maintenance fault codes when using the Stack Exchange platform's native view_count metadata. 978 topics harvested from 24 search queries; 30-sample classification showed 15/30 (50%) served fraction. Package-name/pyprovides line closed on measured grounds: rate of genuine 'which distribution provides this module?' questions is well under 1% of Python import-error reports. KEY lesson: platform-native metadata (view_count via API) works; web search + keyword classifier consistently fails (4/4 domains). Single most useful next action: fresh observation in new domain per D083, recommended starting with medical device alarm codes using FDA MAUDE data.
